BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   B. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   C. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

5. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.

9. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   D. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

14. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   C. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   D. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   C. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
